name: cip.usage.read
description: Codestra CIP optional product scope (usage read) managed by protected Keycloak GitOps. Read metering and usage for the token tenant (and its projects when narrowed). Read-only; no billing or quota mutation. Requested explicitly per short-lived token, issued only to holders of its mapped CIP realm roles, bound to the token tenant_id, and never a realm or client default.
